title: Reconciling a Sponsor's Roster against the Plan's Own Enrollment Records in the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans
content:
The plan reconciles each sponsor's roster against its own enrollment records on the reconciliation cycle scheduled for that plan of the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans, so that nobody is covered who should not be and nobody is billed for cover that ended.

## The condition on recording a finding

The reconciliation finding names the single change record it puts right, and that record stands at not reconciled or disputed with the sponsor.

Each finding names the single change record it puts right, because one file cycle may carry several changes for one retiree. The standing of that record is read from the plan's own change records, before the finding is recorded, and on the very change record the finding names.

## Where the plan and the sponsor disagree

Where the plan and the sponsor disagree, the sponsor has the dispute window scheduled for that plan to answer, and the enrollment stands as it is while the disagreement is worked out.

A retiree is never left without cover because of a reconciliation dispute, and is never billed for a month the reconciliation shows they were not enrolled.

Findings the sponsor never answers inside the dispute window are written off in the retiree's favour, and the record says so plainly.

## Where the retiree came off the roster earlier than the plan knew

Where a reconciliation shows the retiree was taken off the roster earlier than the plan knew, every contribution charged for those months is credited back and any claims paid are recovered from the providers rather than from the retiree.

## Points of judgement

| What the records show | What follows |
| --- | --- |
| The change record the finding names stands at not reconciled | It is one of the two standings the condition names |
| The change record the finding names stands at disputed with the sponsor | It is one of the two standings the condition names |
| The change record stands in any other way | It is not one of the two standings the condition names |
| A disagreement is open and the dispute window has not run out | The enrollment stands as it is |
| The dispute window ran out with no answer from the sponsor | The finding is written off in the retiree's favour, and the record says so plainly |
